blockingFindings.title: Existing source reference preservation is not actually tested
blockingFindings.rationale: This is a must requirement with no effective spec-local coverage for the preservation behavior.
blockingFindings.issue: R1, R2, and R3 require PASS replacement to preserve the existing sourceReview/sourceTriage value from stale canonical artifacts, but the tests seed stale artifacts with the same route-default source values that an implementation would likely hardcode. An implementation that ignores the existing artifact field and always writes route.reviewArtifact/route.triageArtifact would still pass.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Seed stale triage/repair artifacts with distinct existing sourceReview/sourceTriage values, then assert the PASS replacement preserves those exact values.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This is a must requirement with no effective spec-local coverage for the preservation behavior.
